inclusions.text: 7 nights aboard a five-star Nile cruise vessel
inclusions.source: Duration · 8 days / 7 nights aboard a five-star Nile cruise vessel
Your party travels with its own Egyptologist; aboard you have a private cabin on a standard 4–5 star cruise vessel.

inclusions.text: Private cabin on a standard 4–5 star cruise vessel
inclusions.source: Your party travels with its own Egyptologist; aboard you have a private cabin on a standard 4–5 star cruise vessel.

inclusions.text: Meet at Luxor International Airport and transfer to the ship
inclusions.source: You are met at Luxor International Airport and transferred to the ship.
After a final breakfast on the water, you are transferred to Luxor International Airport.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Luxor, transfer to ship
itinerary.source: You are met at Luxor International Airport and transferred to the ship.

itinerary.title: The West Bank
itinerary.source: The first full day crosses to the West Bank — the land the ancient Egyptians set aside for the dead.

itinerary.title: Edfu and the Temple of Horus
itinerary.source: The cruise sails south overnight and arrives at Edfu in the morning.

itinerary.title: Aswan: High Dam, Obelisk, Philae
itinerary.source: The cruise reaches Aswan next, where the Nile narrows toward the first cataract.

itinerary.title: A day on the river
itinerary.source: The next day has no programme.

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo and the return north
itinerary.source: An Oriental Show and another Galabia Party round out the evening on board as the ship continues north.

itinerary.title: Luxor East Bank: Karnak, Luxor Temple
itinerary.source: The cruise returns to Luxor for its final full day, given to the East Bank — the city of the living, as opposed to the West Bank city of the dead visited at the start.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Luxor International Airport
itinerary.source: After a final breakfast on the water, you are transferred to Luxor International Airport.
